# Swim Gen

> Swim Gen is a web application for generating personalized swimming training plans for swimmers, triathletes, trainers, and coaches.

## Public Pages

- [Swim Gen](https://swim-gen.com/): Main application for generating swimming training plans.
- [About Swim Gen](https://swim-gen.com/about): Project background and maintainer information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://swim-gen.com/privacy): Privacy information.
- [Terms of Service](https://swim-gen.com/terms): Application terms.
- [Impressum](https://swim-gen.com/impressum): Legal and contact information.

## Project

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/5pirit5eal/swim-gen): Source repository and project metadata.

## Capabilities

- Generate personalized training plans from user requirements.
- Save plans for authenticated users.
- Refine plans through chat interaction.
- Share plans by URL.
- Upload plans and export plans as PDF files.
- Search swimming drills.
